decisions.reason: The compact dumper remains a close extension of the firm's construction equipment range, and with no sign of failure management would normally continue it.
This articulated dumper fits the core machinery and aftersales model, so absent negative market feedback it is more likely to be retained.
A telescopic loader line with several models reflects a broader platform commitment that a growing mid-sized machinery maker would rarely unwind quickly.
The material lift line is close to the existing offer and the reported large order and rental popularity argue strongly for continuation.
Although newer and more distant from the historic range, the underground mining loader shows convincing early field use and therefore merits further commercialization.
